introduction: The issuex GitLab adapter provides a complete implementation of the forge-neutral Client interface for GitLab REST API v4, supporting repository metadata, issue management, and merge request workflows across gitlab.com and self-hosted GitLab instances.

glossary.CheckRun: A CI/CD pipeline job execution mapped to forge-neutral check run status and conclusion.
glossary.IID: An internal project-scoped identifier used by GitLab for issues and merge requests, distinct from global database IDs.
glossary.MergeMethod: The pull request merge strategy: merge commit, squash and merge, or rebase and merge.
glossary.Note: A GitLab discussion comment or system audit event attached to an issue or merge request.
glossary.SystemNote: An automated audit event generated by GitLab when issue or MR properties change, distinguished by system: true.
glossary.Truncated: A boolean flag indicating that comments or list results reached the fetch cap and more items exist on the server.

requirements.title: GitLab Client Construction, Lifecycle, and Factory Wiring
requirements.rationale: Direct construction and factory integration allow callers to instantiate authenticated or unauthenticated GitLab adapters configured for public or self-hosted instances.

criteria.action: provide a GitLab client adapter struct that implements every method of the Client interface and export the NewGitLab(Options) (Client, error) constructor

criteria.condition: NewGitLab is called with Options
criteria.action: resolve BaseURL from Options or GITLAB_API_URL or default to https://gitlab.com/api/v4 with trailing slashes trimmed and /api/v4 appended when absent, Token from Options or GITLAB_TOKEN, HTTPClient from Options or default 30-second timeout client, and UserAgent from Options or default agent-fox

criteria.condition: NewWithOptions is called with NoOp set to false and the resolved forge type is ForgeTypeGitLab
criteria.action: construct and return the GitLab client adapter instead of returning ErrUnsupportedForge

criteria.condition: NewWithOptions encounters an ambiguous host URL that does not match github or gitlab domain strings
criteria.action: issue GET /api/v4/version to probe for a GitLab self-hosted instance before returning ErrAmbiguousForge
report true from Authenticated() when holding a non-empty token and false otherwise, and close idle HTTP connections on the underlying transport from Close() returning nil

for any outgoing HTTP request, include Accept: application/json and User-Agent headers, appending PRIVATE-TOKEN: <Token> when authenticated and Content-Type: application/json when a request body is present

requirements.title: Project Metadata and URL-Encoded Path Resolution
requirements.rationale: Project metadata inspection verifies project accessibility, permissions, default branch, and allowed merge strategies using URL-encoded paths without extra ID lookups.

criteria.action: for any project-scoped REST endpoint, format the target project path as url.PathEscape(repo.String()) with slashes replaced by %2F without executing numeric project ID lookups

criteria.condition: GetRepository is called with a valid Repo
criteria.action: execute GET /projects/{project_path} and populate a Repository struct with FullName from path_with_namespace, DefaultBranch, Private based on visibility, Archived, and Permissions computed from effective access level

criteria.condition: GetRepository receives a successful project response
criteria.action: record the project merge settings merge_method and squash_option for pull request merge resolution

criteria.condition: GetRepository receives HTTP 404 on a client without an authentication token
criteria.action: return an error wrapping ErrNotFound with guidance indicating the project may be private and require setting GITLAB_TOKEN
criteria.contract: returns an error satisfying IsNotFound(err) == true and containing private project guidance

criteria.condition: GetRepository receives HTTP 404 on an authenticated client
criteria.action: return an error wrapping ErrNotFound
criteria.contract: returns an error satisfying IsNotFound(err) == true

requirements.title: Issue Lifecycle and Retrieval
requirements.rationale: Issue lifecycle methods enable creating, reading with comment history, updating, closing, and filtered listing of GitLab issues with normalized state values.

criteria.condition: CreateIssue is called with a Repo and CreateIssueRequest on an authenticated client
criteria.action: execute POST /projects/{project_path}/issues with title, description, and labels, returning the created Issue with Number set to iid, Title, Body, State normalized to open, URL, Author, Labels, timestamps, and IsPR set to false

criteria.condition: CreateIssue, UpdateIssue, or CloseIssue is called on a client without an authentication token
criteria.action: reject the call and return ErrNoToken without executing network requests
criteria.contract: returns an error satisfying IsNoToken(err) == true

criteria.condition: ReadIssue is called with an IssueRef
criteria.action: execute GET /projects/{project_path}/issues/{number}, normalize state from opened to open, set IsPR to false, and fetch chronological comments via ListComments into IssueThread

criteria.condition: ReadIssue receives an error when fetching comments after successfully retrieving issue metadata
criteria.action: record the comment failure in IssueThread.CommentsErr and return the populated Issue with nil top-level error
criteria.contract: IssueThread has populated Issue, non-nil CommentsErr, and ReadIssue returns nil error

criteria.condition: ReadIssue receives HTTP 404 on an unauthenticated client
criteria.action: return an error wrapping ErrNotFound with guidance that the issue or project may be private
criteria.contract: returns an error satisfying IsNotFound(err) == true and containing private issue guidance

criteria.condition: UpdateIssue is called with an IssueRef and UpdateIssueRequest on an authenticated client
criteria.action: execute PUT /projects/{project_path}/issues/{number} with non-empty fields and state_event if requested, returning the updated Issue struct

criteria.condition: CloseIssue is called with an IssueRef and optional comment on an authenticated client
criteria.action: post the comment via AddComment if non-empty, and execute PUT /projects/{project_path}/issues/{number} with state_event close

criteria.condition: ListIssues is called with a Repo and IssueFilter
criteria.action: paginate GET /projects/{project_path}/issues with state mapped to opened or closed, labels, assignee_username, order_by, and sort query parameters, setting IssueList.Incomplete to true if results reach filter.Limit while additional issues remain

requirements.title: Issue Comments and Label Management
requirements.rationale: Comments and labels provide issue interaction and triage categorization with system-note filtering and idempotent mutation semantics.

criteria.condition: AddComment is called with an IssueRef and comment body on an authenticated client
criteria.action: execute POST /projects/{project_path}/issues/{number}/notes with the comment body and return the comment web URL

criteria.condition: ListComments is called with an IssueRef
criteria.action: paginate GET /projects/{project_path}/issues/{number}/notes with 100 items per page up to a maximum cap of 5 pages (500 notes), filter out notes where system is true, and set CommentList.Truncated to true if the cap is reached with additional notes remaining

criteria.condition: AddLabels is called with an IssueRef and a non-empty slice of label names on an authenticated client
criteria.action: execute PUT /projects/{project_path}/issues/{number} with add_labels containing comma-separated label names

criteria.condition: AddLabels is called with an empty labels slice
criteria.action: return nil immediately without making network calls

criteria.condition: RemoveLabel is called with an IssueRef and label name on an authenticated client
criteria.action: execute PUT /projects/{project_path}/issues/{number} with remove_labels set to the label name, returning nil idempotently even if the label was not present

criteria.condition: CreateLabel is called with a Repo and Label on an authenticated client
criteria.action: execute POST /projects/{project_path}/labels with name, color formatted with leading hash, and description, returning nil when the response is HTTP 201 or HTTP 409 or HTTP 400 with already exists message

criteria.condition: AddComment, AddLabels, RemoveLabel, or CreateLabel is called on a client without an authentication token
criteria.action: reject the call and return ErrNoToken without executing network requests
criteria.contract: returns an error satisfying IsNoToken(err) == true

requirements.title: Merge Request Lifecycle and Diff Inspection
requirements.rationale: Merge request operations support code review workflows, metadata inspection, draft status management, and changed file diff analysis.

criteria.condition: CreatePullRequest is called with a Repo and CreatePullRequestRequest on an authenticated client
criteria.action: prefix title with Draft: if req.Draft is true and prefix is missing, and execute POST /projects/{project_path}/merge_requests with source_branch, target_branch, title, and description, returning the created PullRequest struct with Merged set to false

criteria.condition: ReadPullRequest is called with an IssueRef
criteria.action: execute GET /projects/{project_path}/merge_requests/{number} and return the parsed PullRequest struct with normalized state, draft status, source and target branches, head SHA, and merge status

criteria.condition: ReadPullRequest receives HTTP 404 on an unauthenticated client
criteria.action: return an error wrapping ErrNotFound with guidance indicating the project or merge request may be private
criteria.contract: returns an error satisfying IsNotFound(err) == true and containing private project guidance

criteria.condition: ReadChangedFiles is called with an IssueRef
criteria.action: execute GET /projects/{project_path}/merge_requests/{number}/changes and return a slice of ChangedFile structs with status normalized to added, modified, or deleted and additions and deletions counts parsed from unified diff chunks

criteria.condition: GetPRState is called with an IssueRef
criteria.action: execute GET /projects/{project_path}/merge_requests/{number} and return a PRState struct with Number set to iid, State set to open, closed, or merged, Merged boolean, and HeadSHA

criteria.condition: ClosePullRequest is called with an IssueRef on an authenticated client
criteria.action: execute PUT /projects/{project_path}/merge_requests/{number} with state_event close

criteria.condition: CreatePullRequest or ClosePullRequest is called on a client without an authentication token
criteria.action: reject the call and return ErrNoToken without executing network requests
criteria.contract: returns an error satisfying IsNoToken(err) == true

requirements.title: Merge Request Pipeline Checks, Reviews, and Merge Execution
requirements.rationale: CI status checks, review commenting, and repository-governed merge execution enable complete automation of merge request review and integration pipelines.

criteria.condition: GetCIChecks is called with an IssueRef and a pipeline exists for the merge request
criteria.action: execute GET /projects/{project_path}/merge_requests/{number}/pipelines?per_page=1, query constituent jobs for the latest pipeline, and map job name, status, conclusion, summary, and web URL into CheckRun structs

criteria.condition: GetCIChecks is called with an IssueRef and no pipelines exist for the merge request
criteria.action: return an empty slice of CheckRun structs and nil error

criteria.condition: GetPRReviews is called with an IssueRef
criteria.action: query merge request approvals and non-system discussion notes, map approvals to approved reviews and notes to commented reviews, and return the combined reviews sorted chronologically

criteria.condition: PostReviewComment is called with an IssueRef and body string on an authenticated client
criteria.action: execute POST /projects/{project_path}/merge_requests/{number}/notes with the review body

criteria.condition: MergePullRequest is called with MergeOptions on an authenticated client
criteria.action: construct the merge payload with commit_message, sha if specified, and squash flag governed by MergeMethod or omitted for MergeMethodDefault, executing PUT /projects/{project_path}/merge_requests/{number}/merge and returning MergeResult on HTTP 200

criteria.condition: MergePullRequest receives HTTP 405, HTTP 406, or HTTP 409 from GitLab
criteria.action: return an error wrapping ErrConflict indicating the merge request cannot be merged
criteria.contract: returns an error satisfying IsConflict(err) == true

criteria.condition: PostReviewComment or MergePullRequest is called on a client without an authentication token
criteria.action: reject the call and return ErrNoToken without executing network requests
criteria.contract: returns an error satisfying IsNoToken(err) == true

requirements.title: GitLab REST Transport, Error Handling, and Rate Limiting
requirements.rationale: Bounded memory usage, rate-limit backoff with retry, and canonical error classification ensure resilience against GitLab API failures and throttling.

criteria.action: read all HTTP response bodies through an io.LimitReader bounded to at most 8 MB (8388608 bytes)

criteria.condition: an HTTP response has status 429
criteria.guard: the calculated RetryAfter backoff duration is less than or equal to 120 seconds
criteria.action: invoke the configured sleep function for the backoff duration and retry the request once

criteria.condition: an HTTP response has status 429 and the RetryAfter backoff exceeds 120 seconds, or a retried rate-limited request fails
criteria.action: abort the request and return an error wrapping ErrRateLimited
criteria.contract: returns an error satisfying IsRateLimited(err) == true

criteria.action: for any GitLab REST error response payload, format the HTTPError message from string message, nested object field validation arrays, or error and error_description fields

criteria.condition: an HTTP response returns status 404, 405, 406, or 409
criteria.action: wrap the corresponding sentinel error ErrNotFound for status 404 or ErrConflict for status 405, 406, and 409 in the returned HTTPError

criteria.condition: a custom sleep function is configured on the GitLab client adapter
criteria.action: invoke the custom sleep function instead of time.Sleep during rate-limit backoff retries

execution_paths.title: GitLab issue creation, reading with comments, and closing with comment

steps.action: invokes NewGitLab with authentication token and project repository target
constructs and returns an authenticated GitLab client with normalized API base URL
calls CreateIssue with title, description, and labels
executes POST /projects/{project_path}/issues and returns the created Issue with normalized open state
calls ReadIssue for the created issue reference
executes GET /projects/{project_path}/issues/{number} and fetches issue comments via ListComments filtering system notes
calls CloseIssue with an explanatory closing comment
executes AddComment to post the closing comment and PUTs the issue with state_event close

execution_paths.title: GitLab merge request CI pipeline checks inspection, review commenting, and merge execution

steps.action: invokes NewWithOptions for a GitLab repository and calls ReadPullRequest
executes GET /projects/{project_path}/merge_requests/{number} and returns MR details with head commit SHA
calls GetCIChecks to verify MR CI pipeline job statuses
queries the latest pipeline and its jobs, returning mapped CheckRun records
calls PostReviewComment with approval comments
executes POST /projects/{project_path}/merge_requests/{number}/notes with the comment body
calls MergePullRequest with MergeMethodDefault
executes PUT /projects/{project_path}/merge_requests/{number}/merge and returns the MergeResult

execution_paths.title: Rate-limit backoff and retry recovery on GitLab REST request

steps.action: calls GetRepository on an authenticated GitLab client
executes GET /projects/{project_path} and receives an HTTP 429 response with a Retry-After header of 2 seconds
calculates the backoff duration via RetryAfter() and invokes the injected sleep function for the duration
retries the GET /projects/{project_path} request once
receives HTTP 200 and returns the populated Repository struct to the caller

execution_paths.title: GitLab self-hosted instance probe and repository discovery

steps.action: invokes NewWithOptions with an ambiguous host URL and repository target
executes GET /api/v4/version against the host to detect a self-hosted GitLab instance
constructs and returns a GitLab client configured for the self-hosted instance BaseURL
calls GetRepository to retrieve project metadata
executes GET /projects/{project_path} using URL-encoded project path and returns the Repository struct
